title: JsonField
description: Strict-JSON textarea with a format button and accessible syntax feedback; formatting preserves numbers, escapes and key order.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Syntax feedback is withheld while typing and checked on blur; the button re-indents valid JSON.

indent.title: Indentation and toolbar
indent.description: indent sets the spaces per level (0 compacts); hideToolbar removes the button but keeps the feedback.

form-control.title: With FormField
form-control.description: Disabled, read-only and required states are inherited from the field.

JsonFieldProps.value: JSON text (controlled); omit for an uncontrolled field
JsonFieldProps.defaultValue: Initial text of an uncontrolled field
JsonFieldProps.onChange: Called with the new text on every edit and after formatting
JsonFieldProps.hideToolbar: Hides the format button; syntax feedback stays visible and associated
JsonFieldProps.indent: Spaces per indentation level when formatting (0 to 10; 0 compacts the JSON)
JsonFieldProps.formatLabel: Accessible label of the format button
JsonFieldProps.invalidLabel: Status text prefix for invalid JSON (followed by the parser error)
JsonFieldProps.className: Class name of the outer wrapper

cssVars.--json-field-gap: Space between the toolbar, the editor and the status line
cssVars.--json-field-font-family: Font family of the editor (defaults to the monospace stack)
cssVars.--json-field-tab-size: Rendered width of a tab character in the editor
cssVars.--json-field-status-font-size: Font size of the validation status line
